Checking… Download Broker Connect v2.5.2 Accounts Add your first broker account Zerodha, Upstox, Angel One, Kotak Neo, Fyers, Dhan, Alice Blue, 5paisa, IIFL, AC Agarwal, Zebu, FlatTrade or Shoonya, in your own name. Add an account Sell without a T-PIN every time: enable DDPI Without DDPI, your broker can take shares from your demat account only after you authorise them with your CDSL T-PIN, and a sell is rejected until you do. With DDPI (Demat Debit and Pledge Instruction) active, sells from Place orders go straight through. It is a one-time online form in your broker's app or website (look for DDPI in your profile or account settings; some brokers charge a small fee). Once it is active, mark it in the helper (DDPI next to the account) so we stop asking. Without DDPI: on Dhan the helper can send the T-PIN and open CDSL for you before selling; for other brokers, authorise in their app first. Read from your own broker accounts by the helper on your PC and shown only in this browser. MomentumScore never sees your broker login, holdings or orders. Not investment advice.
